after_fix.behavior: Affected original-base labels request the full L result pool and continue base resolution independently of the count of matching delta hits. Unaffected labels retain the k-result path.
after_fix.mutation_staging: The successor View, including shadow-label bookkeeping, is constructed before WAL append/fsync and is published only after durable append succeeds.
after_fix.shadow_membership: Each immutable view records labels of original base rows shadowed by its delta. Normal batches incrementally add original labels; reopen/compaction catchup reconstruct them. New stable IDs absent from the base do not shadow base labels.
after_fix.threshold_review: The strict worst-merged-distance < exact-sorted returned-base cutoff test conservatively excludes omitted members of that explored ANN pool, including distance ties. This is not a global exact-recall guarantee beyond the explored pool; native per-label connectivity supports pool-exhaustion reasoning.

before_fix.assertion: matching delta hits cannot stop base retries while the base result pool is shadowed
before_fix.evidence: Failing command output observed in this session; actual and expected tuples transcribed without rerunning the old implementation.
before_fix.failure: Merged far delta hits satisfied k even though the bounded base pool was completely shadowed, stopping retries prematurely.

delta_action_smoke.note: Checks action delta separately on a fresh local native index. Query timings are diagnostic and are not performance evidence. Smoke preceded the hot-shadow fix; all stress rows are new-ID-only inserts and do not shadow base rows.

regression.additional_phase: Relabel the next 30 nearest surviving base IDs to label 11, retain their original navigation rows, and compare label7 search with independently recomputed live truth; the earlier snapshot must preserve its original results.
regression.setup_validation: The original native graph query at k10/L10 returns only IDs among the independently ranked 60 deleted records.
regression.truth: Enumerate live stable IDs through snapshot.get, filter current label membership, rank u64 integer squared-L2 to zero by (distance, stable_id).

scope: Local synthetic correctness regression; no native-host performance operation performed.
